environment.description: Production deployment on ECS Fargate with LaunchDarkly flag 'enable-custom-templates' set to TRUE for all users in the 'enterprise' targeting rule. The flag was enabled during a Q3 beta rollout and never reverted. All authenticated users with x-user-tier: enterprise receive the flag value true. No request body validation or template sandboxing is applied at the infrastructure level.

config.ld_flag_enable_custom_templates: true for enterprise tier users (targeting rule active)
config.network: ALB with no WAF attached, public-facing
config.iam: Task role with ssm:GetParameter, s3:GetObject permissions
